senses.gloss:
अभुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
 1. Uneaten.
 2. Unenjoyed, unused, unexpended.
3. One who has not eaten.
 4. One who has not enjoyed or possessed.
E. अ neg. भुक्त eaten.

अभुग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
 1. Straight, not bent.
 2. Well, free from disease.
E. अ neg. भुग्न broken.

अभुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Armless, maimed.
 E. अ neg. भुज the arm.

अभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nonexistent, absent, what is not or has not been.
E. अ neg. भूत been.

अभूमि f. (-मिः) Want of place of refuge or support, destitution, priva-
tion.
 E. अ neg. भूमि site.

अभूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Few, scanty.
 E. अ neg. भूयिष्ठ many.

अभूरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Few, some, several.
 E. अ neg. भूरि many.

अभूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unadorned.
 E. अ neg. भूषित adorned.
